source_lines: Sources: task and environment prices and contract sizes (six to seven figures a quarter): Epoch AI (Jan 2026, 18 interviews), SemiAnalysis (Jan 2026); vendor revenue: Deedy Das (Jul 2026), context only.

Estimates: finance priced at the upper-middle (task floor ~$500, per Mechanize’s ~$2,400 of training compute per task); volume per lab (China benchmarked to UniPat orders), tier counts and the three-domain extrapolation are our assumptions.
Buyers: OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Meta, xAI and other US frontier labs; Thinking Machines, Reflection AI and other new labs; Alibaba, ByteDance, DeepSeek, Moonshot and other Chinese labs.

cards.title: Realistic matching
lines: Naive backtests assume resting orders fill,
so models learn the backtest’s loopholes.
We queue orders, split crossing and resting
fills, and attribute each fill to the book.

cards.title: Risk in the reward
lines: After fixing 3 flaws in a human strategy,
return and risk diverge; the reward counts both

cards.title: No gaming
lines: The last full day is hidden from the agent;
the full report’s hash is published up front;
private reserve tasks replace exposed days

facts: All three founders have quant-firm experience (page 3);
the team designed the three rules above
Interviewees repeatedly name it a key quality test: no high score by gaming
7 environments in 14 days, no outside funding
